_how: Copy this file, fill it in for one person, then run: node scripts/brand-kit.mjs their-brand.json (a kit they run) or node scripts/client.mjs add their-brand.json (you edit their footage on this Mac). Fields starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
name: Jane Doe

colors._note: text = caption color, accent = the highlight (hook keyword, gold word, card accents), stroke = outline, bg = card background

fonts._note: A Google Fonts family name (Bebas Neue, Montserrat ExtraBold, Oswald) or a path to a .ttf. display = hook titles, climax words, pop captions, cover titles, and the serif in the briefing look and serif hook (instead of DM Serif Display); body = reveal captions, cards, carousels. Leave out to keep Anton and Inter.

look._note: hook: headline | gold | box. captions: reveal (word by word) | pop (bold outlined) | quiet (word by word in their body font at 600, smaller, no outline, the keyword in an accent box) | serif (quiet, set in their display serif). annotate: hand-drawn marker on the key word. slams: climax words that stamp in. behind: the hook runs behind their head.
look._case: hookCase / captionCase: upper (ALL CAPS, the default) | sentence (shown as written or as said, no forced caps; for a serif or script display font).
look._hookSeconds: How long the hook stays on screen: seconds (default 3), or "reel" for the whole reel (5-10 s one-line reels).
look._pace: pace: fast (the default: tight silence cuts, punch-ins with jump cuts between them, a cold open on the first b-roll still) | calm (gentler silence cuts, a punch-in at most every 16 s, no jump cuts, no cold open). coldOpen: true or false overrides the pace's cold open.

looks._note: The card looks their reels may use. Leave only empty to allow every house look (receipts, phone, fieldnotes, briefing, press, shopfloor, blueprint, casefile, redline, glass). The brand looks are opt-in and need a serif display font: atelier (cream editorial card), note (Instagram-style white line boxes), serifonlife (the serif straight on the video). Example: ["atelier", "note", "serifonlife", "phone"]. pace calm also means fewer cards (one every 14 s, at most 4).

world: Who they are and where they live and work, for the b-roll: their business, their city, their setting, the things that show up in their life. One or two sentences, concrete.
carouselStyle: The look of their carousel pictures: light, colors, texture. Never another creator's style.
voice: How they talk in captions: who they talk to, words they use, words they never use, how long, emojis or not.
_cta: Client folders only: the on-screen call to action and caption CTA ("Comment PRICE"). Empty = none.
